title: Power of search
question: What does Nscdc Act section 7 say about power of search?
shortAnswer: Nscdc Act s.7 — Search premises/vehicles/persons on reasonable suspicion; seize exhibits; female searched by female.
legalExplanation:
**Section 7 of the Nscdc Act** provides:

Search premises/vehicles/persons on reasonable suspicion; seize exhibits; female searched by female

This provision empowers Nscdc Act officers with specific powers and duties.
practicalOptions: Stay calm. Know your rights. Ask for identification. Do not resist. Ask for lawyer. Document everything.
whatToAvoid: Do not run, bribe, resist, destroy evidence, or sign without lawyer.
whatToDocument: Officer name, agency, badge, vehicle, time, location, witnesses, injuries, photos/video.
whatToDoAfter: Get lawyer. File complaint with agency complaints unit or ICPC/PCR. Demand court within 24h. Document injuries.
